question_text: [Incident Response, Threat Modeling & Forensic Log Analysis - Q40] In Microsoft's STRIDE threat modeling framework, which security property corresponds to the threat of 'Repudiation'?
answer_explanation: Repudiation refers to an attacker performing an unauthorized action and denying it occurred. It is mitigated by Non-Repudiation mechanisms (tamper-evident audit logs and digital signatures).
reference_solution: Correct Choice: C. Rationale: Repudiation refers to an attacker performing an unauthorized action and denying it occurred. It is mitigated by Non-Repudiation mechanisms (tamper-evident audit logs and digital signatures).
